text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Year has finally arrived. As 
for Bamboo Memory at the start of the 
year—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, let's look back at last year's 
thrilling Twinkle Series alongside race 
footage!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's starting!! So exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, at Bamboo Memory's request, we were 
watching a TV program in the trainer's 
office looking back at last year's races 
together...

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
""The Umamusume indispensable to any 
discussion of last year is none other than 
her! The "Monster," Oguri Cap! She created 
countless legendary showdowns!""

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~!! Oguri-senpai right off the bat!! 
As expected of you!!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"I believe the race against the 'White 
Lightning', Tamamo Cross, left a lasting 
impression on many. As a matter of fact, I 
became quite a fan myself—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Ooooh...! You two look so cool...!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—It's no exaggeration to say she's now at 
the center of the Twinkle Series. The era 
of Oguri Cap may very well be upon us—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri-senpai's era...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the end, the program merely looked 
back on Oguri Cap, wrapping up as what was 
practically an Oguri Cap special...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, leaving aside a short-distance runner 
like me, it's pretty surprising—and kind 
of a bummer—that Yaeno and the others 
didn't get any coverage at all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, but that just goes to show how vivid 
and inspiring Oguri-senpai's achievements 
were to everyone... right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to run in a real race with 
Oguri-senpai someday too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The intense awareness of Oguri Cap that 
Bamboo Memory voiced. It evoked scenes of 
the past within me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—...It was a very good race. I want you to 
race again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!! Of course!! Definitely!! We're gonna 
run together again, Oguri-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer-sa..., ...h. U... uguuu~...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"It's so frustrating! Trainer, I'm... I'm 
so frustrated...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Back before Bamboo Memory made her debut. 
That day she competed against Oguri Cap in 
the inter-event tournament, gaining both a 
vow for the future and bitter frustration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since that moment, Oguri Cap has 
remained a special rival that Bamboo 
Memory longs to challenge again someday."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Is there any chance I'll get 
to race against Oguri-senpai in the 
future?
choice_data_list: ……If it were a mile G1, then maybe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Oguri Cap's race history to 
date, her main domains are Mile and Medium 
distances. There's a very strong chance 
she'll appear in a Mile GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The mile— One of the two stages where I 
aim to be the absolute strongest and the 
absolute best...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ………………All right!! I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, when I battle Oguri-senpai in a 
Mile GⅠ, I'm going to beat her! As someone 
aiming to be the strongest on the mile, I 
definitely will!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And I'll make sure I can say it loud and 
proud! That the mile belongs to me... To 
Bamboo Memory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even with the overwhelming praise 
surrounding Oguri Cap, seeing Bamboo 
Memory fearlessly challenge her is truly 
reassuring."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me once again that this 
indomitable spirit is truly Bamboo 
Memory's one-of-a-kind strength.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Still, first up is the sprint race, the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen! I'll definitely 
seize that first step toward becoming the 
best there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"And connect that to a Mile GⅠ too! I'll 
make that declaration a reality, yes 
sir!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just as Bamboo Memory and I reset 
our mindset to be positive—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory and I went on our first 
shrine visit of the year to pray for 
success in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how many wins Oguri'll get this 
year~ Maybe she'll even go undefeated all 
year long!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Nah, isn't that totally possible? I mean, 
Oguri's seriously way too strong right 
now. Whenever she races, she always trends 
on social media—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The people who just walked past us were 
talking about Oguri-senpai, you know? 
She's the talk of the town everywhere~!
choice_data_list:
It must be making that huge of a splash, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, feels like I don't even register on 
their radar. Jeez, fads really are 
something else...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that's that! All I can do is give 
it my all on my own path! Feels like I can 
put even more heart into my prayers this 
year!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Trainer, what are 
you gonna wish for this year?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, sounds good! Whether it's racing or 
training, health always comes first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! I'll follow Trainer's lead 
and pray for good health too, suu-!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, praying for good health in the 
days ahead, the challenge of the Senior 
Year began!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's an amazing drive to improve! 
I wanna grow too! My heart, my body, my 
running—everything!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Praying for my own growth, I'll 
aim for greater heights together with you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, praying for even further growth, 
the challenge of the Senior Year began!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
G-Good luck charms, huh?! That's quite an 
unexpected choice~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, luck really does 
matter in competition... Thinking of it 
that way, this feels like an awesome 
wish...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, pick me! I wanna pray for good 
luck together with you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, praying for good fortune, the 
challenge of the Senior Year began!
